chunks: Ibn Maskān narrated from Ibrāhīm ibn Maymūn, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

Concerning a man who accepts Islam and wants to be circumcised while the time of hajj has arrived: should he perform hajj or be circumcised? He said, “He should not perform hajj until he is circumcised.”

key_terms.ٱلْحَجُّ: the pilgrimage to the Sacred House

ai.seo_question: Should a man who newly enters Islam perform hajj before circumcision?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a convert to Islam who faces both the arrival of hajj and the need for circumcision. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that he should not perform hajj until he has undergone circumcision, indicating its priority in this context.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2815 - Ibn Maskan narrated from Ibrahim ibn Maymun, who reported from Imam Abu Abdullah (as) regarding a man who converts to Islam and intends to undergo circumcision while the time for Hajj has arrived.

He asked: Should he perform Hajj or undergo circumcision?
Imam (as) replied: "He should not perform Hajj until he is circumcised."
